source_revision: not-reviewed: provider terms not read; automation surface per docs/research/headless-ai-coding-controller-verified-2026-10-12.md (R2, 2026-10-12)
notes: Automation surface: `codex exec` with `--json` JSONL and `codex exec resume`, per R2 sections 'Verified provider adapter design' (adapter matrix) and 'Compliance and authentication boundary'; TDD 4.2. Version: Assumption/unverified-on-this-host. R2 states no Codex version number and the codex binary is not installed on the development host, so no real version could be recorded. The range <0.0.0 is deliberately empty and fails closed: every Codex binary yields ADAPTER_VERSION_UNVERIFIED until the operator validates a version (`adapters validate`, FR-OPS-02) or T2.2 records one against an installed CLI. Credentials: Switchboard never reads, copies, logs or exports Codex credentials (including ~/.codex/auth.json, which R2 says is sensitive), never starts login and never scrapes dashboards or reimplements the network protocol; it reuses the CLI's cached login and returns AUTH_REQUIRED naming the native login (ADR-0003, FR-AUTH-02). Terms: this manifest records that the CLI documents headless use (technical evidence only); it makes no claim that any use complies with OpenAI's terms. Commercial, resale, multi-user or credential-sharing use requires a per-provider policy review first (NFR-COMP-01). Review date: 2026-10-12 (Delegated agent review, not owner-approved). Git writes (FR-GIT-01, T2.2): R2 documents no Codex per-command deny or allow rule and no commit or attribution setting (adapter matrix and Codex paragraph: only `--sandbox workspace-write` or stricter, `--ignore-user-config`, `--ignore-rules`). The adapter declares this (`gitWriteControl.kind = none-documented`, reported by list_capabilities); FR-GIT-03 (ref snapshots, M9) and FR-GIT-06 (no push credentials in the agent environment) are the remaining controls. Assumption, unverified (codex not installed; live smoke check X-G1): the workspace-write sandbox blocks writes to a worktree's Git directory, which lives outside the cwd. A non-empty shell allowlist is not compiled for Codex (Ineligible). Native controls (T3.0, 2026-10-13, TDD 4.2.1; Delegated): unverified, documentation only (codex not installed). R2 documents `--sandbox` (bubblewrap on Linux/WSL2, Seatbelt on macOS, a Windows sandbox), `--ignore-user-config`, `--ignore-rules`, `--yolo` and the deprecated `--full-auto`, and no command allowlist, network switch or approval flag. Compile matrix (T3.6, 2026-10-13, Delegated, Proposed; synthetic fixtures only): inspect-untrusted (`--sandbox read-only`, spelling an Assumption) and edit-untrusted (`--sandbox workspace-write`) compile with shell `none` or an empty allowlist (owner decision 10: commands run inside the sandbox, credential confinement unverified, R-23, FR-POL-06 open); trusted-development compiles only with shell `broad` (`--sandbox workspace-write`, or read-only for a read-only workspace or file access); test-sandboxed is Ineligible (PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED, Q-32 Proposed fail closed); in every profile a non-empty command allowlist (Q-11), network other than `off` (allowlist or policy), repository config other than `disabled` and a requested model are Ineligible (CAPABILITY_MISSING), a Git-write allowlist entry is Ineligible (PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED), and trusted-development shell `none` or `allowlist` is Ineligible (CAPABILITY_MISSING); network off is an Assumption. Privileged (T3.6, T3.17, 2026-10-13; Delegated, Proposed): a scope with bypass false compiles from the same documented flags only when its shell is `broad`, its network `off` (Assumption) and its repository configuration `disabled` (`--sandbox workspace-write`, or read-only for read-only files or workspace); shell `none` or `allowlist`, network `allowlist` or `on`, repository configuration `approved` or `enabled` and a requested model are Ineligible (CAPABILITY_MISSING). A scope with bypass true is Ineligible (PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED, "bypass/privileged flag not documented in R2: verify live") whatever its approval: R2 names `--yolo` only as a posture to avoid (L28, L125) and `--full-auto` as deprecated (L126), and documents neither's effect, so no Codex bypass flag is emitted. Sandbox host prerequisites, credential confinement, network behaviour and approval handling are Unknown until the live check T3.9 (R-23, R-37). Linux only; macOS (NFR-PORT-02) and Windows (NFR-PORT-03) are not supported yet. T9.0 spike (2026-10-13; Delegated; documentation only, codex is still not installed on the development host): every Codex question of the spike is Unverified. R2 and the repository's existing citations name `codex exec`, `--json`, `--sandbox`, `--ignore-user-config`, `--ignore-rules` and the platform sandboxes (bubblewrap on Linux/WSL2, Seatbelt on macOS, a Windows sandbox) and say nothing about: how to supply a per-run MCP definition or approve an MCP tool; whether a sandboxed process can connect to a Unix socket (bubblewrap and Seatbelt profiles may block it); a per-command Git deny rule; or any commit or attribution setting. No Codex flag was written from memory. The adapter keeps `gitWriteControl.kind = none-documented`, and the finalize-only mode (FR-GIT-09) is the only design with evidence until a binary is installed and a live check (T3.9 X-G1, or a follow-up) runs. Result: T9.0 is not done for Codex (ROADMAP 6.3).
